title: All Around the World
lyrics: [E]All around the world there's a [D]new day [A]dawning,
There's a [E]sound coming round, there's a [D]new song [A]rising up,
There's a [E]power coming down, there's a [D]glimpse of [A]glory now,
[Bm7]There's a sound of praise, [F#m]There's a sound of war;
[Bm7]Lift the banner high, [F#m]let the Lion roar.[E]
[Bm7]Can you hear the sound [F#m]in the tops of the [E]trees?[EsusE]
[Bm7]Let the lame run, let the [F#m]blind see!
[Bm7]Let Your power come, set [F#m]the captives free![E]
[Bm7]Let the lost return to the [F#m]Lover of our souls,
[Bm7]Let the prodigal find [D]the way back home.[BsusB]
